pull_request.title: Infrastructure: Recover second-device token usage
pull_request.head: infrastructure/device-token-accounting
pull_request.body:
## Change

Fill the four dashboard session logs that lacked usage after PR #18 by recovering this device’s client-reported counters under ADR-004. Add **8,515,036 input tokens and 64,602 output tokens**, preserving the original narratives with dated corrections.

The usage-only inventory reconciles 529 events into 515 request increases after excluding repeated snapshots. No thread/turn IDs overlap PR #18. Retain 22 additional completed turns for 10 branch-only sessions, with exact target revisions and importable entries; six discussion/orientation turns remain unassigned. Four failed turns have unknown usage, and the active recovery snapshot is excluded. Models and missing measurements are not inferred.

The normal journal now contains **98,045,726 input and 477,200 output tokens across 67 turns in 38 of 42 sessions**. These totals exclude pending and unassigned usage; cached input and reasoning output are subsets. No full-project coverage is claimed.

Evidence: `logs/usage/README.md`, `logs/usage/USAGE-2026-09-25-device.json`, and the paired `SESSION-2026-09-25-device-token-backfill` / `SESSION-2026-09-25-device-token-pr` records. This follows PR #18; no separate issue or scientific sign-off applies.

## Dashboard and validation

- [x] Infrastructure change: no maintenance entries added to scientific progress tracking.
- [x] 32 logging/recovery tests and 27 dashboard tests passed during recovery; retained-evidence tests cover both inventories and child attribution. Dashboard tests ran in a temporary clean clone with task edits.
- [x] All four import replays added zero duplicate entries.
- [x] Final publication checks validated 42 session records and dashboard records, built the dashboard, and passed naming/path classification and whitespace checks.
- [x] Original PR #18 inventory, historical narratives, numeric capture evidence and human approval boundaries preserved.

events.text:
Used the existing opt-in recovery tool against this device's selected local
store, with read-only SQLite access. All 529 usage events reconciled against
last-request counters; 14 repeated snapshots left 515 requests. The capture
contains 12 threads, including nine child threads. Persisted turn boundaries
account for all requests. No reset, inherited prefix or unexplained parent
aggregate was observed. No thread/turn pair overlaps PR #18's inventory.

Imported four completed turns into the four dashboard sessions that had lacked
usage: 8,515,036 input and 64,602 output tokens. Previewed each batch and replayed
each import; every replay added zero entries. Historical narratives and original
limitations are preserved with dated corrections.

Retained 22 completed turns for ten branch-only session records as importable
pending evidence. These cover pixel modules, tracker review, magnetic expert
review and conflict repair. Cached Git revisions identify the target records;
those branches were not merged. Six short orientation/discussion turns remain
unassigned. Four failed child turns have no observations, not measured zeros.

Root attribution used selected user-visible requests and session-ID tool
references against curated narratives. Child attribution uses recorded
parent/child edges and parent spawn/followup targets, with activity ordinals
retained in the inventory. No conversation or collaboration-message bodies,
private model state or client-store paths are retained in repository artifacts.
Configured/requested models do not establish actual execution models.
